命令行指引

为了标识身份，建议先完成 Git 全局设置
git config --global user.name "your name"
git config --global user.email "your email"
git clone https://atomgit.com/luguo124/axure.git
cd axure
touch README.md
git add README.md
git commit -m "add README"
git push -u origin master
cd existing_folder
git init
git remote add origin https://atomgit.com/luguo124/axure.git
git add .
git commit
git push -u origin master
git clone --bare https://git.example.com/your/project.git your_path
cd your_path
git remote set-url origin https://atomgit.com/luguo124/axure.git
git push origin --tags && git push origin --all
